resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or open-source planewave DFT code with PBE+D3, implicit solvation, NEB)
Atomic structures of Cu clusters, Cu(100) surface, and graphene

access.notes: Cu cluster geometries (Cu8, Cu13, Cu20, Cu38, Cu55) from published literature (e.g., Zhang et al., Nano Energy 2018; Lim et al., Nanoscale 2014). Cu(100) slab and graphene unit cell from standard crystal structures. Must be generated by the agent from these references.
